Network.label: Network settings
Network.description: Control the connection, retry and version checking behavior of PixivUtil2.

Debug.label: Debugging and logging
Debug.description: Control the debugging page, log output and console display.

IrfanView.label: IrfanView integration
IrfanView.description: Controls whether IrfanView opens after downloads and whether download lists are created.

Settings.label: General settings
Settings.description: Control the download root directory, database and image information output method.

Filename.label: Filenames and folders
Filename.description: Controls naming rules for images, metadata files, series data, and tag folders.

Authentication.label: Login and verification
Authentication.description: Stores authentication information required for Pixiv, Fanbox and Cloudflare login.

Pixiv.label: Pixiv downloads
Pixiv.description: Controls which Pixiv works are downloaded, R-18 filters, and metadata saved to the database.

FANBOX.label: FANBOX download
FANBOX.description: Control how Fanbox covers, article HTML, and work information are saved.

FFmpeg.label: FFmpeg conversion
FFmpeg.description: Controls the FFmpeg executable and arguments used to convert Ugoira into video or animated image formats.

Ugoira.label: Ugoira animation
Ugoira.description: Controls whether source Ugoira files are kept and which converted formats are created.

DownloadControl.label: Download control
DownloadControl.description: Controls file-size limits, update checks, blocklists, post-processing, and archive output.

Network.useproxy.label: Enable proxy server
Network.useproxy.description: When set to True, all network requests will use the proxy specified by proxyAddress.

Network.proxyaddress.label: Proxy server address
Network.proxyaddress.description: Supports http, socks4, and socks5 URLs, including an optional username, password, and port.

Network.useragent.label: Browser User-Agent
Network.useragent.description: Browser identification string sent to Pixiv; usually maintains the browser's current User-Agent.

Network.userobots.label: Read robots.txt
Network.userobots.description: Whether to download and follow the robots.txt rules used by mechanize.

Network.timeout.label: Connection timeout seconds
Network.timeout.description: The connection is considered failed after waiting for more than this number of seconds.

Network.retry.label: Retry attempts
Network.retry.description: The number of retries when a network request fails.

Network.retrywait.label: Number of seconds to wait for retry
Network.retrywait.description: The number of seconds to wait before each retry.

Network.downloaddelay.label: Download delay cap
Network.downloaddelay.description: Maximum random delay before downloading each work; set to 0 to disable it.

Network.checknewversion.label: Check for new version
Network.checknewversion.description: Whether to check for new versions of PixivUtil2 on GitHub.

Network.notifybetaversion.label: Notify about beta versions
Network.notifybetaversion.description: Whether to display beta version update notifications.

Network.opennewversion.label: Open new version page
Network.opennewversion.description: Whether to automatically open the release page in the browser when a new version is discovered.

Network.enablesslverification.label: Verify SSL certificate
Network.enablesslverification.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates; disabling is only recommended if you continue to encounter SSL errors.

Debug.loglevel.label: Log level
Debug.loglevel.description: Available values are CRITICAL, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG, NOTSET.

Debug.enabledump.label: Enable HTML Dump
Debug.enabledump.description: Whether to save the HTML page for debugging when an error occurs.

Debug.skipdumpfilter.label: Skip Dump error codes
Debug.skipdumpfilter.description: Regular expression for error codes that should not save an HTML dump, such as 1.*|2.*.

Debug.dumpmediumpage.label: Save medium pages
Debug.dumpmediumpage.description: Whether to save all medium pages for debugging.

Debug.dumptagsearchpage.label: Save tag search page
Debug.dumptagsearchpage.description: Whether to save the tag search page for debugging.

Debug.debughttp.label: Output HTTP Header
Debug.debughttp.description: Whether to print HTTP headers in the console for diagnosing connection problems.

Debug.disablelog.label: Disable log files
Debug.disablelog.description: Whether to disable PixivUtil2 log file output.

Debug.disablescreenclear.label: Disable Clear Console
Debug.disablescreenclear.description: Whether to retain the main console screen and not clear existing output during the process.

IrfanView.irfanviewpath.label: IrfanView installation path
IrfanView.irfanviewpath.description: The installation directory of IrfanView; it needs to be set when activating the IrfanView function.

IrfanView.startirfanview.label: Launch IrfanView on exit
IrfanView.startirfanview.description: Whether to open downloaded images in IrfanView when PixivUtil2 exits.

IrfanView.startirfanslide.label: Launch slideshow on exit
IrfanView.startirfanslide.description: Whether to start an IrfanView slideshow when PixivUtil2 exits.

IrfanView.createdownloadlists.label: Automatically create a download list
IrfanView.createdownloadlists.description: Whether to automatically create a download list for IrfanView to use.

Settings.downloadlistdirectory.label: Download list directory
Settings.downloadlistdirectory.description: list.txt and the location where the IrfanView download list is saved; if left blank, use the PixivUtil2 directory.

Settings.uselist.label: Read list.txt
Settings.uselist.description: Whether to parse list.txt and use it to update member_id and custom download folder.

Settings.processfromdb.label: Read artist folders from the database
Settings.processfromdb.description: Whether to use the member_id and folder information recorded in the database.

Settings.rootdirectory.label: Image root directory
Settings.rootdirectory.description: Root directory for downloaded images and work folders.

Settings.downloadavatar.label: Download artist avatars
Settings.downloadavatar.description: Whether to download the artist's avatar as folder.jpg in each folder.

Settings.usesuppresstags.label: Exclude suppressed tags
Settings.usesuppresstags.description: Whether to remove tags listed in suppress_tags.txt from %tags%.

Settings.tagslimit.label: Maximum number of tags
Settings.tagslimit.description: Maximum number of tags included by %tags% in filenames; set to -1 to include every tag.

Settings.writeimagejson.label: Output image JSON
Settings.writeimagejson.description: Whether to export compact image metadata as JSON using filenameInfoFormat.

Settings.writeimageinfo.label: Output image text information
Settings.writeimageinfo.description: Whether to export compact image metadata as a text file using filenameInfoFormat.

Settings.writerawjson.label: Output raw JSON
Settings.writerawjson.description: Whether to save the original unmodified image JSON from the source.

Settings.rawjsonfilter.label: Raw JSON field filtering
Settings.rawjsonfilter.description: Comma-separate the JSON fields to remove from writeRawJSON.

Settings.includeseriesjson.label: Output series JSON
Settings.includeseriesjson.description: Whether to output JSON of work series information; non-series works will not have this information.

Settings.writeimagexmp.label: Export XMP information file
Settings.writeimagexmp.description: Whether to export image metadata to an XMP sidecar without modifying the image itself.

Settings.writeimagexmpperimage.label: Output XMP per image
Settings.writeimagexmpperimage.description: Whether to output an XMP for comics or each encoded image; when enabled, it will take precedence over writeImageXMP.

Settings.verifyimage.label: Verify download file
Settings.verifyimage.description: Whether to check whether the downloaded file is a valid image or ZIP.

Settings.writeurlindescription.label: Save URL in description
Settings.writeurlindescription.description: Whether to write URLs found in work descriptions to a URL list in the root directory.

Settings.striphtmltagsfromcaption.label: Remove HTML from description
Settings.striphtmltagsfromcaption.description: Whether to remove HTML tags and their content in the description when outputting metadata; link text will also be removed.

Settings.urlblacklistregex.label: URL blacklist regex
Settings.urlblacklistregex.description: Filtering URLs in work descriptions using regular expressions.

Settings.dbpath.label: Database path
Settings.dbpath.description: Specify the SQLite database to use; leave blank to use the default database.

Settings.setlastmodified.label: Set file modification time
Settings.setlastmodified.description: Whether to set the last modification time of local files based on the upload time of Pixiv works.

Settings.uselocaltimezone.label: Use local time zone
Settings.uselocaltimezone.description: Whether to use the local time zone when outputting text information and XMP.

Settings.defaultsketchoption.label: Pixiv Sketch default options
Settings.defaultsketchoption.description: Skips the Pixiv Sketch prompt for member_id downloads: y always includes Sketch and n always excludes it.

Filename.filenameformat.label: Artwork filename format
Filename.filenameformat.description: File name template used for general images; reserved characters will be cleaned, and the full path can be up to 250 characters.

Filename.filenamemangaformat.label: Comic page file name format
Filename.filenamemangaformat.description: The file name template used for each page of the comic; can be used with %page_index% or %page_number%.

Filename.filenameinfoformat.label: Image information file name format
Filename.filenameinfoformat.description: File name template used for image JSON, text information, XMP and other information files.

Filename.filenamemangainfoformat.label: Comic information file name format
Filename.filenamemangainfoformat.description: The file name template used for comic information files.

Filename.filenameseriesjson.label: Series JSON file name format
Filename.filenameseriesjson.description: The file name template used by series information JSON, commonly used are %manga_series_id% and %manga_series_title%.

Filename.filenameformatsketch.label: Pixiv Sketch file name format
Filename.filenameformatsketch.description: File name template used in Pixiv Sketch works.

Filename.filenameformatnovel.label: Novel filename format
Filename.filenameformatnovel.description: Filename template for Pixiv novels; commonly includes the series ID, series order, and URL filename.

Filename.avatarnameformat.label: Avatar file name format
Filename.avatarnameformat.description: File name template used by artist avatars; fewer available substitution variables than for regular images.

Filename.backgroundnameformat.label: Background image file name format
Filename.backgroundnameformat.description: Filename template for artist background images; fewer substitution variables are available than for regular images.

Filename.tagsseparator.label: Tag separator
Filename.tagsseparator.description: The delimiting character used between tags in a file name; %space% or %ideo_space% can be used.

Filename.createmangadir.label: Create comic folder
Filename.createmangadir.description: When downloading comics mode, whether to create a folder based on the _pxx segment of image_id.

Filename.usetagsasdir.label: Create folders with search tags
Filename.usetagsasdir.description: Whether to append the query tags of tagslist.txt to the root directory as the saving folder.

Filename.urldumpfilename.label: URL list file name format
Filename.urldumpfilename.description: URL list file name in strftime format; default is url_list_%Y%m%d.

Filename.usetranslatedtag.label: Use translated tags
Filename.usetranslatedtag.description: Whether to use translated tags for %tags% in the file name.

Filename.tagtranslationlocale.label: Tag translation language
Filename.tagtranslationlocale.description: Locale used to translate tags, such as en.

Filename.custombadchars.label: Custom invalid-character rules
Filename.custombadchars.description: Regular-expression rules applied when sanitizing filenames.

Filename.customcleanupre.label: Custom filename cleanup rules
Filename.customcleanupre.description: Regular expressions that remove or clean filename content using PixivUtil2 cleanup syntax.

Authentication.username.label: Pixiv username
Authentication.username.description: Pixiv username or email address for OAuth login.

Authentication.password.label: Pixiv password
Authentication.password.description: OAuth password for login; PixivUtil2 will read this setting in clear text, please protect the file properly.

Authentication.cookie.label: Pixiv Cookies
Authentication.cookie.description: Pixiv login cookie; may be automatically updated by PixivUtil2 after successful login.

Authentication.cookiefanbox.label: Fanbox Cookies
Authentication.cookiefanbox.description: Cookies used by fanbox.cc usually do not need to be filled in manually.

Authentication.cookiefanboxtemp.label: Fanbox temporary cookies
Authentication.cookiefanboxtemp.description: A temporary cookie used by the Fanbox login process.

Authentication.refresh_token.label: OAuth Refresh Token
Authentication.refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token used to avoid frequent sign-ins; normally generated automatically during login.

Authentication.cf_clearance.label: Cloudflare clearance
Authentication.cf_clearance.description: Cloudflare clearance cookie; only required when encountering Cloudflare verification.

Authentication.cf_bm.label: Cloudflare bot management
Authentication.cf_bm.description: Cloudflare bot management Cookie; fill in only if required.

Pixiv.numberofpage.label: Maximum number of pages processed
Pixiv.numberofpage.description: Number of pages to process; set to 0 to process all pages.

Pixiv.r18mode.label: Download R-18 only
Pixiv.r18mode.description: Whether to list only works tagged R-18 when searching for members, bookmarks, and tags.

Pixiv.r18type.label: R-18 type filter
Pixiv.r18type.description: 0 means downloading both R-18 and R-18G, 1 means downloading only R-18, and 2 means downloading only R-18G.

Pixiv.dateformat.label: Pixiv date format
Pixiv.dateformat.description: The strftime format of Pixiv datetime; leave blank to use the default YYYY-MM-DD.

Pixiv.autoaddmember.label: Add artists automatically
Pixiv.autoaddmember.description: Whether to automatically write the artist member_id into the database during all downloads.

Pixiv.autoaddtag.label: Automatically add tags
Pixiv.autoaddtag.description: Whether to automatically write the work tags into the database when downloading.

Pixiv.autoaddcaption.label: Automatically add description
Pixiv.autoaddcaption.description: Whether to automatically write the work description into the database when downloading.

Pixiv.autoaddseries.label: Add series automatically
Pixiv.autoaddseries.description: Whether to automatically write series information into the database during all downloads.

Pixiv.aidisplayfewer.label: Exclude AI-generated works
Pixiv.aidisplayfewer.description: Whether to exclude AI-generated works whose aiType is 2.

FANBOX.filenameformatfanboxcover.label: Fanbox cover file name format
FANBOX.filenameformatfanboxcover.description: The file name template used by Fanbox article cover images.

FANBOX.filenameformatfanboxcontent.label: Fanbox content file name format
FANBOX.filenameformatfanboxcontent.description: The file name template used for images in Fanbox articles.

FANBOX.filenameformatfanboxinfo.label: Fanbox information file name format
FANBOX.filenameformatfanboxinfo.description: File name template used by Fanbox article information and HTML.

FANBOX.writehtml.label: Output Fanbox HTML
FANBOX.writehtml.description: Whether to write Fanbox articles as HTML; non-articles will be judged based on text length and number of pictures.

FANBOX.mintextlengthfornonarticle.label: Minimum text length for non-articles
FANBOX.mintextlengthfornonarticle.description: When writeHtml is enabled, the minimum amount of text that non-articles must have before outputting HTML.

FANBOX.minimagecountfornonarticle.label: Minimum number of images for non-articles
FANBOX.minimagecountfornonarticle.description: When writeHtml is enabled, the minimum number of images that non-articles must have before outputting HTML.

FANBOX.useabsolutepathsinhtml.label: HTML uses absolute paths
FANBOX.useabsolutepathsinhtml.description: Whether Fanbox HTML uses absolute file paths; False uses relative paths.

FANBOX.downloadcoverwhenrestricted.label: Download restricted article covers
FANBOX.downloadcoverwhenrestricted.description: Whether to still download article covers when Fanbox articles are restricted.

FANBOX.downloadcover.label: Download Fanbox cover
FANBOX.downloadcover.description: Whether to download cover images for Fanbox articles.

FANBOX.checkdbprocesshistory.label: Check Fanbox processing history
FANBOX.checkdbprocesshistory.description: Whether to skip unchanged Fanbox articles based on updated_date in the database.

FANBOX.listpathfanbox.label: Fanbox creator list file
FANBOX.listpathfanbox.description: Fanbox creator list with one creator per line; the native setting does not support a custom path.

FFmpeg.ffmpeg.label: FFmpeg executable
FFmpeg.ffmpeg.description: FFmpeg executable file path; you can fill in the full path or the file name that can be found in the system PATH.

FFmpeg.ffmpegcodec.label: WebM encoder
FFmpeg.ffmpegcodec.description: The FFmpeg codec used when building WebM, such as libvpx-vp9.

FFmpeg.ffmpegext.label: WebM file extension
FFmpeg.ffmpegext.description: The container extension used when building WebM.

FFmpeg.ffmpegparam.label: WebM FFmpeg parameters
FFmpeg.ffmpegparam.description: The complete parameters passed to FFmpeg when building WebM.

FFmpeg.mkvcodec.label: MKV encoder
FFmpeg.mkvcodec.description: The codec used when creating MKV; copy means no recoding.

FFmpeg.mkvparam.label: MKV FFmpeg parameters
FFmpeg.mkvparam.description: Parameters passed to FFmpeg when building MKV.

FFmpeg.webpcodec.label: WebP encoder
FFmpeg.webpcodec.description: A codec used when building WebP animations, such as libwebp.

FFmpeg.webpparam.label: WebP FFmpeg parameters
FFmpeg.webpparam.description: The complete parameters passed to FFmpeg when creating WebP animations.

FFmpeg.gifparam.label: GIF FFmpeg parameters
FFmpeg.gifparam.description: The complete parameters passed to FFmpeg when creating a GIF, usually including palettegen/paletteuse.

FFmpeg.apngparam.label: APNG FFmpeg parameters
FFmpeg.apngparam.description: The complete parameters passed to FFmpeg when creating the APNG.

FFmpeg.avifcodec.label: AVIF encoder
FFmpeg.avifcodec.description: Codec used when creating AVIF animations, such as libaom-av1.

FFmpeg.avifparam.label: AVIF FFmpeg parameters
FFmpeg.avifparam.description: The complete parameters passed to FFmpeg when creating an AVIF animation.

FFmpeg.verboseoutput.label: Show FFmpeg verbose output
FFmpeg.verboseoutput.description: Whether to display detailed commands and output content of FFmpeg.

Ugoira.writeugoirainfo.label: Export Ugoira frame information
Ugoira.writeugoirainfo.description: Whether to write Ugoira information for each frame into the information ZIP; writeImageJSON will also include this information.

Ugoira.createugoira.label: Create Ugoira file
Ugoira.createugoira.description: Whether to create Pixiv's native .ugoira animation file.

Ugoira.createmkv.label: Create MKV
Ugoira.createmkv.description: Whether to convert Ugoira to MKV; requires FFmpeg, the default is usually no re-encoding.

Ugoira.createwebm.label: Build WebM
Ugoira.createwebm.description: Whether to convert Ugoira to WebM; requires FFmpeg.

Ugoira.createwebp.label: Build WebP
Ugoira.createwebp.description: Whether to convert Ugoira to animated WebP; requires FFmpeg.

Ugoira.creategif.label: Create GIF
Ugoira.creategif.description: Whether to convert Ugoira to GIF; requires FFmpeg.

Ugoira.createapng.label: Create APNG
Ugoira.createapng.description: Whether to convert Ugoira to animated PNG; requires FFmpeg.

Ugoira.createavif.label: Create AVIF
Ugoira.createavif.description: Whether to convert Ugoira to animated AVIF; requires FFmpeg.

Ugoira.deleteugoira.label: Delete Ugoira after conversion
Ugoira.deleteugoira.description: Whether to delete the generated .ugoira file after the conversion is completed.

Ugoira.deletezipfile.label: Delete ZIP after conversion
Ugoira.deletezipfile.description: Whether to delete the original ZIP image file after Ugoira conversion is completed.

DownloadControl.minfilesize.label: Minimum file size
DownloadControl.minfilesize.description: Skip files smaller than this size; set to 0 to disable this limit.

DownloadControl.maxfilesize.label: Maximum file size
DownloadControl.maxfilesize.description: Skip files larger than this size; set to 0 to disable this limit.

DownloadControl.checklastmodified.label: Check file modification time
DownloadControl.checklastmodified.description: Skip if the local file modification time is the same as the work upload time; setLastModified needs to be enabled.

DownloadControl.alwayscheckfilesize.label: Always check file size
DownloadControl.alwayscheckfilesize.description: Even if there is already a record in the database, re-obtain the remote size to confirm the file status.

DownloadControl.overwrite.label: Overwrite files of different sizes
DownloadControl.overwrite.description: Whether to delete the old file and re-download it when the file sizes are different; backupOldFile can save the old file first.

DownloadControl.backupoldfile.label: Back up old files
DownloadControl.backupoldfile.description: Whether to rename the old file to a backup file with Unix time before re-downloading.

DownloadControl.daylastupdated.label: Number of days between artist updates
DownloadControl.daylastupdated.description: Only process member_ids that have been at least this many days since the last check.

DownloadControl.checkupdatedlimit.label: Downloaded works check upper limit
DownloadControl.checkupdatedlimit.description: Jump to the next member_id after seeing the specified number of existing works; alwaysCheckFileSize needs to be turned off.

DownloadControl.useblacklisttags.label: Enable tag blacklist
DownloadControl.useblacklisttags.description: Works containing the blacklist_tags.txt tag will be skipped.

DownloadControl.useblacklisttitles.label: Enable title blacklist
DownloadControl.useblacklisttitles.description: Works whose titles contain the string blacklist_titles.txt will be skipped.

DownloadControl.useblacklisttitlesregex.label: Compare titles using regular expressions
DownloadControl.useblacklisttitlesregex.description: Whether to treat each line in the title blocklist as a regular expression.

DownloadControl.datediff.label: Work age limit
DownloadControl.datediff.description: Only process new works within the specified number of days; set to 0 to disable it.

DownloadControl.enableinfiniteloop.label: Enable infinite loop for tag downloads
DownloadControl.enableinfiniteloop.description: Whether to continuously poll for new entries when tag downloads are performed in newest to oldest order.

DownloadControl.useblacklistmembers.label: Enable artist blocklist
DownloadControl.useblacklistmembers.description: Skip the specified member_id according to blacklist_members.txt in the application directory.

DownloadControl.downloadresized.label: Download medium size image
DownloadControl.downloadresized.description: Whether to download medium size images instead of original size.

DownloadControl.skipunknownsize.label: Skip files of unknown size
DownloadControl.skipunknownsize.description: Whether to skip downloading when alwaysCheckFileSize is enabled but the remote size is unknown.

DownloadControl.enablepostprocessing.label: Enable post-download processing
DownloadControl.enablepostprocessing.description: Whether to execute postProcessingCmd after each file is downloaded.

DownloadControl.postprocessingcmd.label: Post-download command
DownloadControl.postprocessingcmd.description: The command to be executed after each download is completed; use %filename% to substitute the file name, and command errors will not be handled.

DownloadControl.extensionfilter.label: File extension filter
DownloadControl.extensionfilter.description: Acceptable file extensions are separated by |, for example jpg|png|gif|ugoira.

DownloadControl.downloadbuffer.label: Download buffer KB
DownloadControl.downloadbuffer.description: The download buffer size (KB) to use before writing to disk; usually leave it at the default of 512.

DownloadControl.createpixivarchive.label: Create Pixiv zip file
DownloadControl.createpixivarchive.description: Whether to download the work as a ZIP archive instead of creating a folder.

DownloadControl.createpixivarchivecompre.label: Compression algorithm
DownloadControl.createpixivarchivecompre.description: ZIP_STORED, ZIP_DEFLATED, ZIP_BZIP2, or ZIP_LZMA; the default ZIP_STORED is no compression.

DownloadControl.createpixivarchivecompre.label: Compression level
DownloadControl.createpixivarchivecompre.description: The compression level used by ZIP_DEFLATED or ZIP_BZIP2; valid range is 0 to 9.

DownloadControl.autoextractzip.label: Automatically decompress ZIP
DownloadControl.autoextractzip.description: Whether to automatically decompress and organize the contents after downloading the ZIP.

DownloadControl.deletezipafterextract.label: Delete ZIP after unzipping
DownloadControl.deletezipafterextract.description: Whether to delete the original ZIP file after automatic decompression is completed.
